correctness.rationale: On the exact symmetric U=[0,2a+g]×[0,b] union two upward side rectangles of widths a and depth q, inclusion–exclusion at actual Git RESULT.md (blob a6422b7daada43d248bf5ed5d3285493a386fc88) reduces V_U−P_U to two independent L-corner deficits minus the opposite-arm collision Γ. For q<g/2 the first deficit is 2∫_0^{t−q}(t−sqrt(t²−z²))dz ∼ (t−q)^3/(3q). For q>g/2 the newly contacting arms contribute a length-2(t−g/2) vertical rectangle of height q−t and an upper half disk lens, with leading negative linear and 3/2 powers; at q=g/2 the lower lens strip removes only O(s²). Thus the polynomial reach is min(q,g/2), including equality. The geometric derivation controls all t near contact, not just a grid. Independent Shapely union-buffer area evaluations at q=.7,1,1.4 and g=2 confirm onset signs and first scale; approximation errors at the exact threshold were explicitly recognized.
